test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

The graph presents total sales (in ₹ crore) of three companies over six years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6407804f4b4c22a390a625dcaa53f146847167d4dea09106b700bd82f79e63b.png] 

For which of the given pairs of years are the total sales of all three companies together equal?
solution:
**Calculation**

The total sales of all three companies together in 2011 = 80 + 78 + 41 = 199

The total sales of all three companies together in 2012 = 56 + 56 + 45 = 157

The total sales of all three companies together in 2013 = 78 + 67 + 54 = 199

The total sales of all three companies together in 2014 = 67 + 56 + 56 = 179

The total sales of all three companies together in 2015 = 81 + 78 + 67 = 226

The total sales of all three companies together in 2016 = 76 + 65 + 59 = 200

**The answer is 2011 and 2013.**
